scope: all non-PING Discord interactions before any mutation or deferred effect

outcomes: acquired with an opaque fencing lease token

completion.operation: fenced durable completion using the exact acquired lease
completion.falseOrError: completion-uncertain; never automatically retry the effect
completion.effectFailure: retain the durable claim and record a sanitized failure without releasing it
completion.waitUntilScheduling: not replay completion; provider-backed durable enqueue and effect completion are required

requiredDurability: claim and duplicate observation are atomic
completed claims remain observable for the full Discord retry horizon
no local memory or workstation dependency
provider-backed durable enqueue, effect completion, and crash recovery are proven before activation
